label: Wimpy UK "Allergen & Nutritional Guide" PDF (brand asset on their own S3 bucket wimpy-uk.s3-eu-west-2.amazonaws.com)
notes: 2-page brand PDF, per-portion values. Column headers are rotated 90 degrees and pdfplumber returns them mirrored (")lack( ygrenE"), and extract_tables() splits each menu section into a values table plus a separate allergen table, so generic_pdf.fetch_from_pdf returns 0 rows here. Parsed instead from extract_text() lines with the regex "<name> <9 numbers>" (kJ, kcal, fat, saturates, carbs, sugars, fibre, protein, salt) — name and numbers come off the same text line so column alignment cannot drift. 197 matching lines, 156 unique items. Guards applied: kJ/kcal ratio must sit in 3.5-5.0, and protein*4 <= kcal*1.15 — 0 violations. Cross-check: Wimpy Cheeseburger 440 kcal matches the figure published on wimpy.uk.com menu pages.
